comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body:
1.Speak to Scholar in London Archives
2.Browse Book of Archeology (requires English or a use of Germanic Translation Note)
3.Speak to Scholar again
4.Browse Book of Archeology again
5.Speak to Scholar again
6.Speak to Port Official
7.Sail to Bergen and speak to the Sculptor there (he's at the Craft Shop)
8.Speak to Sculptor again
9.Discovery is at British Isles North at the north-center part of the map next to Ruins.
